name: Corral Hollow
summary: Corral Hollow is a community shopping center in Tracy, California, managed by Regency Centers and featuring a diverse mix of retail, dining, and service tenants. With nearly 1,900 reviews and a 4.2-star rating, it serves as a convenient neighborhood destination for the growing East Bay community.
demographics: Corral Hollow serves the growing Tracy community, which attracts young families and middle-income households drawn to the area's affordable housing and proximity to Bay Area employment centers. The trade area consists primarily of suburban residents with household incomes in the $60,000-$100,000 range, including many commuters working in the San Francisco Bay Area. Shoppers typically visit for convenient, everyday needs including groceries, dining, and essential services, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns reflecting the commuter-oriented lifestyle of the area.
description: Corral Hollow is a community shopping center strategically located at 1801-1975 West 11th Street in Tracy, California, serving as a convenient retail destination for the rapidly growing East Bay community. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, a preeminent national owner and operator of shopping centers, this property exemplifies the company's focus on creating thriving neighborhood centers in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics. The center features a diverse mix of retailers, restaurants, salons, medical offices, and fitness facilities, providing essential goods and services to Tracy residents and commuters. With extended operating hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Corral Hollow accommodates the busy schedules of working families and professionals in the area. The shopping center has earned strong community recognition, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from nearly 1,900 reviews, demonstrating its role as a valued retail hub in Tracy's expanding retail landscape.
